payload.explanation: Set the general Hyprland input natural-scroll option to false and the nested touchpad natural-scroll option to true in the user input configuration.

steps: In the user Hyprland input configuration, set the general input natural-scroll value to false.
In the nested touchpad configuration, set natural-scroll to true.
Reload Hyprland, confirm there are no configuration errors, then physically verify one mouse-wheel scroll and one touchpad scroll.

payload.effects: Mouse-like devices use conventional scrolling while the touchpad uses natural scrolling. Device classification or future compositor syntax changes may affect applicability.
payload.rollback: Remove the two user overrides or restore the preferred values, then reload Hyprland and check configuration errors.
payload.validation_plan: Confirm the two effective settings, check compositor configuration errors, and physically scroll once with the intended mouse and touchpad in an application with visible content.

activation.details: Reload Hyprland and inspect configuration errors after editing the user input configuration.
